### Claim 4 — Paired session-object grant shape
**Verdict:** PASS-with-clarification
**Evidence:** `templates/a.rs:172-191` `session_grant` carries: `holder: PrincipalRef::Agent(lead)`, `action: vec![Read, Inspect, List]`, `fundamentals: vec![DataObject, Tag]`, `descends_from: Some(adoption_auth_request_id)` (same AR as project_grant). The `resource.uri` is a selector-grammar predicate string `tags contains "project:{project}" AND tags contains #kind:session` (`:181`), not a literal path-form `session_object/<uuid>`. The ADR §D54.3 (file `0054-session-launch-manifest-and-hard-deny-flip.md:79`) describes this as *"`resource.uri` (`session_object/project:<id>` selector form)"* — both forms are semantically equivalent reaches; the chosen string-literal-tag form sidesteps a grammar limitation (digit-leading UUIDs cannot form an identifier-form `namespace_tag`; see `templates/a.rs:160-171` block comment). Tag `#kind:session` IS present in the predicate (`:181`).
